input.question: The kurds are becoming widely respected by western opinion. Is it the first time that a group with a "middle eastern" appearance is so much respected by the West?
input.ground_truth: Most certainly not. The West has respected people of what we now call the Middle East through all of history. The Middle East was not lightly called the cradle of civilization. Figures from Abraham through Moses to Jesus to Saladin, who was himself a Kurd, and empires from Assyria to the Caliphates, have inspired respect.
